conventions.initialization: No double measurement on initialization; discontinuous n resets histories and memory; >25 nonfinite calls invalidates memory until rel<=1.
conventions.process: Skip the transport step including P increment when F24<1; otherwise Q0 each active tick. Exact imported delag2 gain update after uses of previous beta.
conventions.band: BandEstimate(huber=False); process-local REL_MAX=inf removes only relative-sigma rejection.
conventions.K5: Last finite returned k held on control ticks; k_eff>0,t>.5; accumulated count*TC; max ratio on same ticks.
conventions.scoring: Unchanged own-arm round2 masks, finite estimates pooled; sustained complete contiguous 13-tick windows outside events.
conventions.ripple: Mean per-run whole-episode 20.8Hz ripple RMS, unchanged metric; crossing force RMS pooled fax-FD on rise|fall|reversal.
conventions.K6: Elsewhere excludes case7 before group means.
conventions.K7: Plateau pools 30 originals; sustained compares six reporting groups and original fast/slow splits.
